question: At which cervical vertebral level is the primary tumour (GTVp)?
why: Needs the GTVp from the RTSTRUCT and the vertebrae from TotalSegmentator. The RTSTRUCT GTVp spans z -990 to -1004 mm (centroid about -997); TotalSegmentator 2.18 full resolution puts the C6 centroid at z -985.8 and C7 at -996.7, so C6-C7, mostly C7. A glottic primary at C6-C7 fits an 87-year-old, whose larynx sits low.
